test_title: PYST 44: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Beside oneself

options.text: To stand for one’s own fault

solution:
The correct answer is Almost out of one's senses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given 'beside oneself' is 'almost out of one's senses'.
 
• Beside oneself: overcome with worry, grief, or anger; distraught. 
 
 
• ​Example: She was beside herself with rage.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Correct answer: Almost out of one's senses
